What it is

Inner Focus™ Collagen Plus

The formula has three main ingredients. Bioactive Collagen Peptides, which Nu Skin material says help stimulate collagen and elastin production. Lutein from marigold flowers, a carotenoid that helps protect skin from oxidative stress. And phytoceramides from wheat lipid extract, which help keep the skin’s moisture barrier healthy.

In a third-party, double-blind, placebo-controlled study over 4 months, Collagen Plus was graded as helping improve skin texture, radiance and overall appearance.

Who it suits

Good if you want to care for your skin from within, especially alongside topical skin care. Do not use it if you are allergic to wheat.

How to use

How to take or use it

01

How to take it

Mix one stick pack into 8 oz (240 ml) of water and drink once daily.

02

Warm drinks?

Yes. Mix with cold or warm drinks up to 80°C (176°F) without reducing the collagen peptides’ efficacy.

03

Storage

Store in a cool, dry place.

FAQ

Common questions

How is it different from regular collagen?

According to Nu Skin material, its collagen peptides have a specific peptide “fingerprint” that showed the strongest stimulation of collagen production in lab tests, checked for consistency in every batch. Lutein and phytoceramides are the “plus”.

Do I need topical products with it?

No. It was shown to work on its own. But per Nu Skin material, results look better alongside topical care such as ageLOC LumiSpa.

What is SCS certification?

It means the product is expected to raise your Skin Carotenoid Score, read by the Pharmanex BioPhotonic Scanner.

Why does collagen matter?

Collagen is a structural protein in skin, bones, muscles and other tissues. According to Nu Skin material, adult production falls about 1.5% each year.
